environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster. Namespace 'workflows' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline applied at cluster level via namespace label sync controller. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-egress-metadata' with spec.validationFailureAction: Enforce denies pods without annotation 'network.company.io/imds-exempt: true' from running unless their containers include a sidecar named 'egress-filter' with image 'internal-registry/istio-proxy:1.20-hardened'. The istio sidecar mesh configuration has a ServiceEntry denylist for 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR ranges with DENY action in AuthorizationPolicy. Pod SecurityContext is forced to runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true via the baseline PSS enforcement.

istio_mesh_config.authorization_policy: DENY on metadata and internal CIDRs
